dynamicSlides.title: Our Understanding of the Brief
dynamicSlides.tagline: Key takeaways from Naik Wealth's requirements

rows.title: What Naik Wealth Wants
rows.body: A platform extending 35+ years of advisor-led, relationship-first investing into a digital experience.

rows.title: What We're Deliberately Not Doing
rows.body: Not a replacement for the advisor, but an extension. Technology serves the relationship, not the other way around.

rows.title: Scope
rows.body: Phase 1 core platform for web and mobile (iOS/Android), plus advisory team tools.

dynamicSlides.title: The Business Goal
dynamicSlides.tagline: The single north-star metric this platform is built to serve
dynamicSlides.rightText: This platform is specifically designed to serve this overarching business objective, driving growth and client retention.

dynamicSlides.title: Three Pillars to Reach the Goal
dynamicSlides.tagline: The client relationship is the anchor connecting all three growth drivers

rows.title: Increase Top-Ups
rows.body: Encourage existing customers to invest more, more often.

rows.title: Reduce Exits
rows.body: Keep customers invested for longer, minimizing churn.

rows.title: Increase Referrals
rows.body: Leverage word-of-mouth from happy customers as the primary acquisition engine.

dynamicSlides.title: Key Research Findings
dynamicSlides.tagline: Insights shaping our strategic approach

rows.title: Transactional Platforms
rows.body: Most wealth platforms (Dezerv, ET Money) are transactional with minimal advisor presence.

rows.title: Desire for Calm
rows.body: Investors want simplification, not more data. Platforms that simplify win on experience.

rows.title: Relationship as Growth Lever
rows.body: For Naik Wealth, the relationship has always been the strongest growth driver.

rows.title: Communication is Key
rows.body: 72% of clients leave advisors due to poor communication, ahead of performance.

dynamicSlides.title: Our Strategic Point of View
dynamicSlides.tagline: Beyond just wealth growth, focusing on trust
dynamicSlides.leftText: Advisory isn't only about maximising wealth growth for your customers.
dynamicSlides.rightText: The advisor should provide a sense of trust — and that relationship is what keeps someone invested through a bad quarter, not returns alone.

dynamicSlides.title: Reimagining the Wealth App
dynamicSlides.tagline: From portfolio-led to advisor-led, embracing 'phygital'
dynamicSlides.leftText: So what if we turned the typical wealth app around from portfolio-led to advisor-led?
dynamicSlides.rightText: Not purely digital but phygital. Digital where it helps, personal where it matters — because anything fully digital works against a relationship-driven model.

dynamicSlides.title: Our Solution: Advisor-Led Experience
dynamicSlides.tagline: Key features reflecting the relationship-first approach

rows.title: Open with Advisor's Voice
rows.body: The homepage leads with the advisor’s note, not a portfolio value.

rows.title: Make the Relationship Visible
rows.body: Visits, milestones, check-ins – a dedicated place in the app.

rows.title: Recommendations Traceable to Conversation
rows.body: Read as a reflection of a real advisor conversation, not system-generated.

rows.title: A Reminder, Never a Replacement
rows.body: The app's role is to reflect the relationship, not replace direct communication channels.

dynamicSlides.title: Five Systems, One Platform
dynamicSlides.tagline: A premium digital engagement layer for high-value investors

rows.title: Mobile App
rows.body: For investors — iOS & Android.

rows.title: Web App
rows.body: For investors — desktop & tablet.

rows.title: Middleware
rows.body: Central orchestration layer.

rows.title: Advisor Copilot
rows.body: For the advisory team — mobile.

rows.title: Back Office
rows.body: For compliance & operations — web.

dynamicSlides.title: System Interconnections
dynamicSlides.tagline: Orchestrating investor and team interactions
dynamicSlides.leftText: Investor-facing systems: Mobile App & Web App. Designed for seamless client engagement and portfolio visibility.
dynamicSlides.rightText: Naik Wealth team systems: Advisor Copilot & Back Office. Supported by Middleware for central orchestration, data flow, and integration with third-party services.

dynamicSlides.title: Investor App Modules (1/2)
dynamicSlides.tagline: Core functionalities for mobile and web applications

rows.title: M1: Onboarding & Registration
rows.body: OTP, PAN, KRA, profile setup, orientation, prospective client capture.

rows.title: M2: Investment Account Setup
rows.body: Risk profiling, video KYC, bank linking, nominee, FATCA/CRS, strategy selection.

rows.title: M3: Financial Profile & Wealth Aggregation
rows.body: Account Aggregator consent, external wealth import, goal audit, consolidated view.

rows.title: M4: Home & Portfolio
rows.body: Advisor voice-led home, full portfolio view with XIRR/CAGR, goal health, holdings.

rows.title: M5: Recommendations
rows.body: Nudges on home, full detail in Portfolio. Approve/reject/discuss, bundled actions, tax at exit.

rows.title: M6: Goals & Planning
rows.body: Goal library, adaptive formation, lifecycle chart, future readiness, inflation adjustment, calculators.

dynamicSlides.title: Investor App Modules (2/2)
dynamicSlides.tagline: Advanced features and account management

rows.title: M7: Reports & Statements
rows.body: Capital gains, transaction history, CAS, ELSS proof, performance reports, export options.

rows.title: M8: Advisory & Relationship ('Together')
rows.body: Advisor/team profiles, communication links, market commentary, scheduling, relationship timeline.

rows.title: M9: Research & Content
rows.body: Fund factsheets, comparison, market updates, educational library, inline explainers.

rows.title: M10: Notifications & Alerts
rows.body: Transaction, SIP, portfolio, document, goal, and market/advisory alerts via FCM.

rows.title: M11: Account & Settings
rows.body: Profile, risk profile, bank/nominee, notification preferences, display, security, KYC status.

rows.title: M12: Security & Authentication
rows.body: OTP login, biometric, session management, transaction 2FA, device management.

dynamicSlides.title: Middleware Modules (1/2)
dynamicSlides.tagline: The central engine for platform operations and integrations

rows.title: W1: API Gateway
rows.body: Screen-shaped API composition, caching, rate limiting, graceful degradation.

rows.title: W2: Authentication & Session
rows.body: OTP, biometric sessions, 2FA, lockout, multi-device management.

rows.title: W3: Investwell Mint Connector
rows.body: Portfolio data, holdings, transaction history sync.

rows.title: W4: Account Aggregator Connector
rows.body: Consent lifecycle, data fetch, renewal, failure handling (Setu integration).

rows.title: W5: KYC/KRA Connector
rows.body: KRA status queries, video KYC integration via Digio, status lifecycle.

rows.title: W6: Market Data & Utilities
rows.body: NAV feed, factsheets, NACH mandate registration, market index feeds.

dynamicSlides.title: Middleware Modules (2/2)
dynamicSlides.tagline: Advanced engines and compliance support

rows.title: W8: Recommendation Engine
rows.body: Recommendation state machine, advisor-led enforcement, goal-impact computation.

rows.title: W9: Goals & Projection Engine
rows.body: Lifecycle projections, inflation adjustment, future readiness, adaptive checkpoints.

rows.title: W10: Tax Computation Engine
rows.body: FIFO lot-level STCG/LTCG, exemptions, 'wait and save' advisory.

rows.title: W11: Behavioural Event Tracking
rows.body: Event ingestion, pattern detection, nudge triggers, throttling.

rows.title: W12: Notification Orchestration
rows.body: Push (Firebase), email, channel preferences, frequency controls.

rows.title: W13: Content & Compliance API
rows.body: Serves maker-checker-gated commentary and recommendations to the app.

dynamicSlides.title: Advisor Copilot Modules
dynamicSlides.tagline: Essential tools for the advisory team

rows.title: AC1: Client Directory
rows.body: Client list, status, profile completion, account setup progress, quick actions.

rows.title: AC2: Recommendation Authoring
rows.body: Create individual/bundled recommendations, submit for compliance, track approval.

rows.title: AC3: Client Conversations & Notes
rows.body: Log call summaries, meeting notes, WhatsApp follow-ups. Feeds relationship timeline.

rows.title: AC4: Visits & Scheduling
rows.body: Schedule and log in-person visits, mark founder visits, coordinate calendar.

rows.title: AC5: Client Insights
rows.body: Portfolio health, drift alerts, upcoming milestones, behavioural nudges for advisor action.

rows.title: AC6: Push & Handoff
rows.body: Push notifications for compliance approvals, investor responses, RM handoff workflows.

dynamicSlides.title: Back Office Modules
dynamicSlides.tagline: Operational and compliance management for Naik Wealth

rows.title: BO1: Cohort Management
rows.body: Create and manage user cohorts for targeted recommendations and commentary.

rows.title: BO2: Content Publishing
rows.body: Author and publish market commentary (text, video, podcast) and educational content.

rows.title: BO3: Maker-Checker Workflow
rows.body: Compliance review queue for recommendations and investor-facing content.

rows.title: BO4: Audit & Compliance
rows.body: Full audit logs, consent records, operational reports for compliance.

rows.title: BO5: CRM Integration
rows.body: Zoho CRM sync for leads, conversions, call requests, task creation.

rows.title: BO6: Operational Dashboards
rows.body: Goal history, recommendation analytics, call queue, funnel metrics.

dynamicSlides.title: Our Implementation Approach
dynamicSlides.tagline: How we move from a signed proposal to a shipped product

rows.title: 01 Discovery
rows.body: Stakeholder interviews, competitive study, API review, workflow mapping, detailed project plan.

rows.title: 02 Strategy
rows.body: Information architecture, user journey maps, UX strategy, wireframes for all systems.

rows.title: 03 Design
rows.body: High-fidelity UI, design system, data-heavy component design, prototype delivery, design QA.

rows.title: 04 Development
rows.body: React Native/React/Node.js development, third-party integrations, embedded QA, UAT, deployment.

dynamicSlides.title: Recommended Technology Stack
dynamicSlides.tagline: Robust and scalable choices for the platform

rows.title: Mobile App (investors)
rows.body: React Native — iOS & Android

rows.title: Web App (investors)
rows.body: React / Next.js — desktop & tablet

rows.title: Middleware
rows.body: Python/Node.js — auth, business logic, integrations, engines

rows.title: Advisor Copilot (mobile)
rows.body: React Native — iOS & Android

rows.title: Back Office (web)
rows.body: React / Next.js — role-specific compliance & ops workflows

rows.title: Database & Caching
rows.body: PostgreSQL (transactional), Redis / Memcache (caching)

dynamicSlides.title: AI Integration Strategy
dynamicSlides.tagline: Leveraging AI responsibly in wealth management

rows.title: Advisory Recommendations
rows.body: Human-authored and compliance-reviewed. AI models will not produce financial advice due to high compliance weight.

rows.title: Market Commentary & Content
rows.body: Market commentary videos, educational content, and general market updates can be AI-generated.

rows.title: AI-Driven Design & Development
rows.body: AI can enhance the design and development of investor and client-facing applications.

dynamicSlides.title: Security, Performance & Compliance
dynamicSlides.tagline: Enterprise-grade fundamentals across every system

rows.title: Security
rows.body: OWASP Top 10, API security, OTP/biometric auth, TLS 1.3, AES-256, no full Aadhaar storage, RBAC.

rows.title: Performance
rows.body: API response time targets, distributed caching, last-known-value fallback, background data sync, load testing.

rows.title: Compliance
rows.body: Maker-checker for content/recommendations, timestamped consent ledger, full audit trail, MFD-aligned workflow.

dynamicSlides.title: Governance Methodology
dynamicSlides.tagline: Ensuring transparent and efficient engagement

rows.title: Daily Reviews
rows.body: Daily project check-ins with the client to discuss progress and blockers.

rows.title: Weekly Reviews
rows.body: Weekly project review with the Naik Wealth team covering dependencies, risks, and design handoffs.

rows.title: Documentation
rows.body: Versioned technical architecture, API specs, data model, workflows, test cases, and handover documentation.

rows.title: Stakeholder Communication
rows.body: Fortnightly status reports to leadership, milestone-based sign-off, and impact-assessed change requests.

dynamicSlides.title: Post-Launch Analytics & Optimization
dynamicSlides.tagline: Continuous improvement and ongoing partnership

rows.title: 6 Months Post-Launch
rows.body: Analyze app performance, usage analytics, engagement patterns, feature adoption, and Advisor Copilot observations. Structured report with recommendations.

rows.title: Annual Cadence
rows.body: Repeat analytics review annually to track changes, suggest improvements, and refresh the product roadmap. Priced separately.

dynamicSlides.title: Exclusions: Design & Scope
dynamicSlides.tagline: What is outside the current proposal

rows.title: Design Exclusions
rows.body: Photography, videography, illustration production, brand identity design, marketing collateral, print design, custom icon creation beyond design system.

rows.title: Product & Scope Exclusions
rows.body: In-app two-way messaging, direct fund execution by investor, all Phase 2 features, AI-based content generation embedded in the platform.

dynamicSlides.title: Exclusions: Technical & Client Responsibilities
dynamicSlides.tagline: Clear delineation of roles and responsibilities

rows.title: Technical Exclusions
rows.body: Third-party software licenses, WhatsApp Business API integration, data migration, ongoing maintenance and support post-launch.

rows.title: Client Responsibilities
rows.body: Content authorship, Investwell API credentials, Zoho CRM access, AA/KYC provider selection, compliance review, App Store access, branding assets, timely feedback.
